race.comment: ALLTOGETHERNOW (1) turned in a strong run last time when second at Warrnambool 10 days ago. That was only the second run back from a spell, so there should be plenty of improvement to come and he can go on with it here. FIOROWNGOOD (4) comes through the same race and ran third, 2 lengths behind ALLTOGETHERNOW, which isn't a heap of ground to have to make up. He's been ultra-consistent this prep and there's no reason he won't be around the mark again. TAMWOOD (6) was in the money at Coleraine when resuming two runs back then could only manage fifth at Warrnambool over 1400m a week-and-a-half ago. Has ability and rates among the chances. COLD TRAIN (3) did nothing first-up but will be better for it and will relish the step up in trip. TEAR APART (7) should be at peak fitness now after four runs back and should be suited up to this trip, being a son of Shocking.
